item.description: NANAIMO — Jackie Wasyluk says she walks along the shores of Cable Bay near Nanaimo, B.C., almost every day, and was shocked when she visited Tuesday after hearing of a spill.

item.title: Josh Manson has 2 goals, 2 assists and a fight as Avalanche rout Senators 8-2
item.description: DENVER (AP) — Defenseman Josh Manson had two goals, two assists and a fight as the Colorado Avalanche beat Ottawa 8-2 on Thursday night for their seventh straight victory over the Senators.

item.title: Federal immigration officers shoot and wound 2 people in Portland, Oregon, authorities say
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (AP) — Federal immigration officers shot and wounded two people in a vehicle outside a hospital in Portland, Oregon, on Thursday, a day after an officer shot and killed a driver in Minnesota, authorities said.

item.title: Will K-pop earn its first Grammy in 2026? Maybe, but it's complicated
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Two things can be true at once. K-pop is an inextricable force in global pop culture, and it has long been undercelebrated at institutions like the Grammys — where K-pop artists have performed but have never taken home a trophy.

item.title: Mound of garbage collapses at Philippine landfill, burying and trapping 38 people and killing 1
item.description: MANILA, Philippines (AP) — An avalanche of garbage and debris buried or trapped workers in low-slung buildings at a landfill in the Philippines, killing one person, injuring a dozen and leaving 38 others missing, officials said Friday.
